name: marephraem-ideathon-2026
description: Full-Stack Registration, Administration, Reporting, and PDF Management Platform for MAREPHRAEM IDEATHON 2026

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
